source.title: Rogue DPS Pre-Raid Gear - WoW Classic - Icy Veins
source.note: The benchmark's claim per slot: Icy Veins' 'best' outranks every other candidate. Candidates aren't ranked among themselves. 'best' is Icy Veins' phase 4 pick, the latest pre-raid list. 'alternatives' are its phase 1-3 picks that phase 4 replaced. 'extraCompetitors' are added from elsewhere (see extraCompetitorsSource) and only when no source ranks them at or above the best; disputed items are left out.

extraCompetitorsSource.title: Rogue DPS Pre-Raid Best in Slot (BiS) Gear Guide - WoW Classic - Wowhead
extraCompetitorsSource.note: Labelled Season of Mastery Phase 1, so it's used only for competitors, never for 'best'. Taken: its 'Optional' rows in slots where its 'Best' matches Icy Veins'. Left out as disputed: Pendant of Celerity (22340, a second 'Best' neck) and Precisely Calibrated Boomstick (2100, its 'Best' ranged, where Icy Veins picks Blackcrow). Imperial Jewel (11933) was added by the user.
